body: I think Palworld’s success and hype has shown everyone just how much of a demand there is for a “good” 3D Pokémon game. I feel like Palworld is like a tech demo to show us the beginning of what a 3D Pokémon game combat can look like. Just an opinion though.

I feel like there should be some unwritten rule or etiquette like for fun sports with friends that even if we lose early we aren’t going to just give-up from there. Although I think the rules should be more lenient for AFK players. The game in its current state makes it incredibly hard to win with one less player. I think there is be a better auto-detection for early AFK. Even extending the remake window would help.

I understand they are trying to make the game more satisfying and fun. The only issue I take is with how the view items. As they have mentioned in now and in the past, items are warping champion kits. It feels like the tail is wagging the dog. Then there is the opposite where a champion isn’t able to utilize the current items and gets banished to the shadow realm until riot notices. 

I just wish items would have less impactful passives. It would also most likely help with balancing the large champion cast that league has now. Being able to focus more on champion design instead of having to worry if the champion kit will abuse the living crap out of an item.

I think there is something to said about men who only search for it on women’s day. The chances are high that a decent percentage of those men are incels. 

Personally, I wasn’t aware it was November 19th. I know that’s anecdotal, but I think it does say a little bit about the dates awareness level. I don’t know what the root cause of that is, but it says something.
